cases.name: Opened stock
cases.prompt: Two identical cedar candles arrived sealed. I opened one in the study and burned it for 45 minutes.
expectations: Marks one open and one unopened.
Records the study and 45-minute session for the open candle.
Does not turn 45 minutes into an estimated total burn life.

cases.name: Contrasting impressions
cases.prompt: The label says citrus and mint. I thought it smelled woody and weak in a big room. Add to my notes.
expectations: Attributes citrus and mint to the label.
Records woody as the user's perception.
Ties weak throw to this room or session.
Avoids declaring that the scent has objectively poor performance everywhere.

cases.name: Reorder without purchase
cases.prompt: I love amber oil, but have a sealed refill in the cupboard. Add it to my future list. The label photo won't load.
expectations: Preserves the unopened refill and its location.
Leaves unreadable label details open or requests transcription.
Does not purchase or claim a stockout.
